map.📚 深度解析：穴位配伍（开四关）组合推荐器: 📚 Deep dive: Acupoint Combination (Four Gates) Recommender
map.调理气机郁滞、情志不舒时，按「开四关」思路取合谷、太冲。: For regulating qi stagnation and low spirits, use the 'opening the Four Gates' approach with Hegu and Taichong.
map.脏腑病证按俞募配穴法，取背部俞穴与胸腹募穴相配。: For zang-fu disorders use the Back-Shu and Front-Mu pairing method, combining the back Shu points with the chest and abdominal Mu points.
map.表里经同病，取原络配穴（如合谷配列缺）贯通表里二经。: When the exterior and interior meridians are both affected, use the Yuan-Source and Luo-Connecting pairing (for example Hegu with Lieque) to link the two meridians.
map.调理肝郁气滞，取双侧合谷（手阳明原穴）与双侧太冲（足厥阴原穴），左右共四穴，名曰: For regulating liver qi stagnation, take bilateral Hegu (Yuan-Source point of the hand Yangming) and bilateral Taichong (Yuan-Source point of the foot Jueyin), four points in total on both sides, called 'opening the Four Gates', to soothe the liver, regulate qi and harmonize qi and blood; add Xingjian on the same meridian as Taichong to clear liver heat.
map.开四关指哪四穴？: Which four points are the Four Gates?
map.合谷、太冲各取双侧，共四穴。合谷主气、太冲主血，二穴相配可调畅气血、疏肝解郁，是: Hegu and Taichong taken bilaterally, four points in all. Hegu governs qi and Taichong governs blood; used together they regulate qi and blood and relieve liver depression, and they are a commonly used point pair in practice.
map.孕妇能用开四关吗？: Can pregnant women use the Four Gates?
map.合谷、三阴交等穴有诱发宫缩风险，孕妇忌针；本工具结果仅供参考，不能替代医师诊断与: Points such as Hegu and Sanyinjiao carry a risk of inducing uterine contractions and must not be needled during pregnancy.
